failureAssessment.cause: The outer label filter uses the already ancestor-scoped header locator as its has locator. The actual wait log re-enters the dialog and section from within each label; it cannot match that descendant query.
failureAssessment.relevantMethodContract: Playwright Locator.filter({has}) evaluates its inner locator relative to the outer locator, so it must not depend on an ancestor outside the outer match.
failureAssessment.cleanupQualification: After the timeout, slow.restore emitted IV_CSV_HELD_READ_CLEANUP_FAILURE and slow.dispose completed. The original click/tap timeout remained the case error.
failureAssessment.notReached: The header-unchecked/review, replacement, release, cancellation and later Canceled.csv assertions after the header-toggle were not reached in these two cases.

after.evidence: The unchanged-source guard runs before both reduced outcome rows. Both actual rows were emitted; the later strict eight-case acceptance check then failed.

exitEvidence.strictAcceptanceError: The eight browser cases did not all pass exactly once.

cleanup.actualMessage: Owned Report CSV tooling/output and copied files removed.
